name: Uldum
summary: In Tanaris’s southern mountains, Uldum’s colossal gates remain sealed. Ancient wards and machinery hide the Titan research compound from explorers.

sections.title: The Gates of the Makers
sections.body: Uldum’s great stone gateway still bars the way in the southern mountains of Tanaris. The Titans built the compound while ordering ancient Kalimdor. It was a vast facility for shaping and overseeing the planet’s biosphere. Titan wardens and defensive constructs once guarded its bounds. Today, only the massive arches can be seen; what lies beyond remains out of mortal reach.

sections.title: The Sealed Secrets
sections.body: Dwarven scholars study the clear signs of Titan craft at Uldum, but they have found no key or mechanism to open the complex. Legend points to the lost Plates of Uldum as the means to reach its secrets. For now, the scholars can only look toward an empire they cannot enter.

faq.q: Can you open the gates to Uldum?
faq.answer: No. Massive stone gates bar the mountain pass, and no mechanism or key in the surrounding desert opens them.
Ancient records and Titan lore describe Uldum as a vast research facility built by the Titans to study and enhance Azeroth’s biosphere. Titan safeguards keep the exact details hidden.

faq.q: What are the Plates of Uldum?
faq.answer: The Plates of Uldum are ancient data discs made by the Titans. Lore preserved by ancient stone keepers says the plates hold the knowledge needed to reach Uldum’s work and facilities.

angles.text: As a dwarf pursuing your Titan heritage through the Explorers’ League, you can see Uldum’s colossal gates as one of Kalimdor’s greatest unsolved mysteries.
Alliance scholars hope to reach the Titan secrets hidden in the southern mountains before a rival power does.
